_meta.note: PUBLISHED tier: analysis only. Party names, case names, party descriptions, citation URLs, source strings and exact dates are removed, not scrubbed. Row-level dollar figures are banded (`amt_band`). Category totals in `billed` ($M) are exact sums over the counted rows of a category and are shown only for categories of five or more cases; a smaller category carries a band in `billed_band` and no exact total. What remains is the analysis: scheme, stage, failed control and COSO/GB mapping. Source crosswalk retained privately by the maintainer and available on request. Allegations only; presumed innocent.
_meta.ctrl_legend: In cases_doj, `ctrl` uses the case base's own shorthand C-01 to C-10 for a control area. It is not a control ID of the HPI-CT library. Only the state patterns in cases_state name library control IDs (for example PI-20).
